purpose: Required timestamp fields and rules for any future P6 rekey implementation. Infrastructure contract only; scientific rekey research is NOT yet implemented (RKEY-B currently violates this schema).
hard_rule: new_anchor_active_time >= rekey_trigger_time; changing future data must NEVER move a historical rekey earlier
prohibitions: no backdated signals from a rekey that was not yet knowable
no repainting of the coordinate system before the rekey trigger is confirmed

current_status.RKEY_A: compliant (re-anchor at the crossing bar, causal)
current_status.RKEY_B: VIOLATION - scans bars i+1..i+4 (future) and assigns the anchor at bar i; rekey_trigger_time effectively moves with future data (measured repaint diff 1.033 on real data)
current_status.RKEY_C: timing-compliant (trailing only) but crashes on warm-up NaN (int(NaN)) - blocked robustness defect

validation: src/mve/causality.validate_rekey_events() enforces field presence and ordering; tested in tests/mve/test_causality.py::test_rekey_schema_validation
